description: This file contains a test utility class `BasketBuilder` used to create and configure instances of the `Basket` class for unit tests in the eShopWeb application.

classes.name: BasketBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating `Basket` objects with predefined or custom configurations to facilitate unit testing.

methods.name: BasketBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing a BasketBuilder instance with an empty basket.

methods.name: WithNoItems
methods.description: Creates a `Basket` mock with no items and a predefined ID.

methods.name: WithOneBasketItem
methods.description: Creates a `Basket` mock with a single item added.
